mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear evening at Harriet Park with a First Quarter moon. If you look up at 6:34 PM, you can catch the International Space Station traveling from the Cross Plains area toward Madison near Home Depot, staying low on the horizon. Tonight will dip to 33 degrees, and we have no rain in the forecast.

The city is hosting a public information meeting on December 8 from 5:00 to 6:30 PM at the Verona Senior Center to discuss the paving and bridge replacement project for the Military Ridge State Trail. Additionally, please remember that all curbside refuse and recycling must be out by 7:00 AM, with carts placed away from obstructions.
Today features yoga at Insight Wellness, while tomorrow is a big night for trivia fans with events at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a recent report, on November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM, so there is still time to stop by for a treat.
